newsitem.title: FRANCE: India GDP rise seen 6.5-7 pct in 1997/98 - advisor.
newsitem.headline: India GDP rise seen 6.5-7 pct in 1997/98 - advisor.

text.p: India is expected to show growth in gross domestic product of 6.5 to seven percent in the 1997/98 financial year, India's chief economic advisor said on Wednesday.

"Assuming a normal monsoon, we should see growth of the order of 6.5 to seven percent in 1997/98 GDP," economic advisor Shanker Acharya told a news conference after a meeting with international donors here.
He said that the 1996/97 GDP growth estimate of 6.8 percent was likely to be revised downward in July to 6.2-6.3 percent.
Earlier on Wednesday, international donors at the World Bank Paris office pledged $6.7 billion in aid to India, slightly more than last year's $6.6 billion.
